content:
Looking at the upper half of the disk (from diameter AB), the angles around O on one side of a line sum to 180°.

The known angles: 20° + 30° + 35° + 40° = 125°.

The shaded sector's central angle = 180° − 125° = 55°.

Probability = (shaded sector angle) / (full circle angle) = 55/360 = 11/72.

\boxed{11/72}
